about: Invented pages. Study devices (a radar sensor, smartwatches) and a technique are not infrastructure; a core imaging facility and a testing service are.

pages.title: Nightwatch study
pages.text: The Nightwatch study examines whether nocturnal hypoglycaemia can be detected without needles. In each bedroom a ceiling mounted radar sensor is installed to track motion during sleep. Participants also wear wrist-worn smartwatches that are used to collect data on physiological symptoms.

pages.title: Imaging
pages.text: The Example Light Microscopy Core Facility is open to researchers from all faculties and to industry partners. The group uses magnetic resonance imaging to study inner ear anatomy in many of its projects. We also offer a biomechanical testing service for implant manufacturers on a fee basis.
